whoItsFor: Developers and game modders who own PC games and want an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) to reverse-engineer, mod, generate assets for, and test them.
useCases: Add new features or content to a PC game (e.g. new weapons or units) with an AI agent
Generate sprites, 3D models, or audio for a game mod using fal
Record and cut showcase videos of in-game mods

requirements.runtime: Git, Python 3.10+, ffmpeg (uv recommended; Blender needed for 3D to sprite renders)
